blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed.

movementDuration.title: Movement Duration
movementDuration.description: Set the duration in seconds of the full movement for each device. Enter in the first field the name of the device and in the second field the duration in seconds.

liftCalibration.title: Lift Calibration
liftCalibration.description: Per-device mechanical end-stop calibration. Matter 0% maps to 'top', Matter 100% maps to 'bottom' on the Overkiz scale (0..100). Use this when a blind does not reach its physical fully-open or fully-closed position at the default 0/100 values. Enter the device name and a pair of integers [top, bottom] with top < bottom. Example: "Küche": [23, 85].

exposeMyPositionSwitch.title: Expose My position trigger
exposeMyPositionSwitch.description: If enabled, each cover device that supports the Somfy 'my' favorite position will get an additional OnOff trigger device. Turning the trigger on recalls the favorite position and then auto-resets.

myPositionSuffix.title: My position suffix
myPositionSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the cover label to name the My-position trigger device (e.g. 'My', 'Lieblingsposition'). Used by Siri / Google / Alexa as the spoken name.

myPositionAlias.title: My position alias (io-stack devices)
myPositionAlias.description: For devices that expose 'goToAlias' instead of 'my' (typical for io-stack roller shutters), this alias is sent as parameter. Default 'favorite1' matches Somfy's standard My-position slot. Change to 'favorite2' etc. if your favorite is stored on a different slot.

disableTilt.title: Disable tilt for these devices
disableTilt.description: Device names listed here will be exposed as lift-only even if the underlying TaHoma device declares a setOrientation or setTilt command. Useful when auto-detection misfires.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable the debug for the plugin (development only)

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
